tei:div.tei:p: .(dkar chag dang po/)* ༄༅/ 'dir rje sna tshogs rang grol gyi bka' 'bum chos tshan gyi rnam grangs ji ltar bzhugs pa'i rim pa bkod par glegs bam/ ja)pa la/ theg chen shing rta'i srel gnyis las ji ltar byung ba'i byang chub sel skyed 'begs chog thar pa'i gru gzings ldeb/ 90 bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i las gzhung me tog phreng mdzes kyi dgongs don mdor bsdus pa nges don snying po ldeb*/ 9 rig 'dzin rat+na gling pa'i gte kha phur pa yang gsang bla med kyi bsnyen bsgrub dmigs rim zin bris ldeb/ 4 yi dam gnyen po lha gsum gyi bsgom bzlas zab mo ldeb/ 4

* (dkar chag gnyis pa/) phyag rdor stobs po che'i nyams len rgyun khyer zin bris ldeb 5 phyag rdor dregs 'dul gyi rtsa bsnyen dmigs rim mdor bsdus ldeb/ 3 gu ru drag sgrub kyi nyams len rgyun khyer zin bris ldeb/ 6 dbang drag 'bar ba'i dbang bskur gyi zin bris ldeb/ 4 dkon mchog gi drung du mchod pa 'bul ba la nye bar mkho ba ldeb/ 3 chu gter gyi rim pa ji ltar bya tshul mdor bsdus te bkod pa bltas chog bdud rtsi'i 'dod 'jo ldeb/ 9 gter ma'i lhan thabs kyi nyer mkho ldeb/ 6 brul gtor cha lnga pa'i rim pa ji ltar bya tshul ldeb/ 5 brul gtor (dkar chag gsum pa/) skabs kyi dogs gcod dri lan gyi 'phros don ldeb/ 3 chu gter shin tu bsdus pa nyams su blang thabs yid bzhin snying po ldeb/ 5 gsur mchod ye shes sprin phung ldeb/ 3 bsang gsur bsngo ba'i cho ga rgyas pa phrin las myur 'grub 'dod 'byung yid bzhin sprin phung ldeb/ 5 gsang sngags nang gtor gyi ngag 'don bdud rtsi'i rlabs phreng ldeb/ 4 bla sgrub sdug bsngal mun sel gyi gtor bsnges ldeb/ 14 tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i rnam par bshad pa mdor bsdus nye bar mkho ba dngos grub sbrang rtsi'i zil mngar ldeb/ 6 (dkar chag bzhi pa/)tshogs mchod shin tu bsdus pa ldeb/ 3 bla ma dgongs 'dus rdzogs rim zab mo bdud kyi gcod yul rgyun khyer ngag 'don nyams su blang ba'i rim pa ldeb/ 9 gcod yul bdud rtsi kun khyab kyi ngag 'don ldeb/ 2 dgongs 'dus kyi sgyu lus mchod sbyin ldeb/ 2 gcod yul shes rab ral gri'i nyams len snying por dril ba ldeb/ 3 sa 'dul gyi gar 'chams la nye bar mkho ba'i rnam bshad zin ris ldeb 13 thugs chen yang snying 'dus pa'i dbang bskur gyi las rim ji ltar bya tshul ldeb/ 31 bcas bzhugs/
